task_commit_basis: first parent of https://github.com/xoofx/markdig/commit/d47fbc757fcad7c55cfd05be303cd1449cd7d6f5, a squash merge; the compare of the two touches exactly the pull request's files

reference_change.title: Optimize PipeTable parsing: O(n²) → O(n) for 3.7x–85x speedup, enables 10K+ row tables

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/xoofx/markdig/pull/922 (PipeTableParser): a .NET program that parses one pipe table of 600 rows to HTML (eval/tasks/workloads/xoofx-markdig-pr922/EvalPipeTable), copied into the tree

oracle.source: Markdig's pipe table tests (the pull request changes no test file; the tests cover PipeTableParser); targeted tests only, built for net9.0 and run on the .NET 10 runtime through DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major

evidence.note: description: the pipe table parser nested the inline tree one level per cell, so cell boundaries cost O(n^2); the description reports 100 to 500 rows as 42x slower and a 3.7x to 85x speedup

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Runs natively with the .NET SDK 10.0.402 that the eval user has in ~/.local/dotnet (docs/evaluation.md, T3.8), so the runtime gate identifies it. Under the sandbox profile MSBuild hung for ten minutes and then failed with no error with its default worker nodes and shared compiler server (the cause is not isolated, and neither is which of the three flags below is the one that matters; the same build takes about a second outside the profile), so every dotnet build and test here passes -m:1 -nodeReuse:false -p:UseSharedCompilation=false. NuGet packages come from the local feed ~/.local/dotnet/nuget-feed (a confined restore could not reach nuget.org: bad certificate format; the cause is inferred, not isolated)
